name: Buckle Box, Printable In One Piece

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable rectangular container consisting of two symmetrical box halves, a bottom and a top lid, connected by an integrated multi-segment interlocking hinge. On the front side opposite the hinge, the box features a robust latching mechanism with a pivoting buckle latch on the bottom half that snaps over a corresponding rod on the top half. Both box compartments have thin, uniform walls and open interiors, designed to lie flat when fully opened.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric box with an integrated interlocking hinge and a snap-fit buckle latch. The design must allow customization of the box dimensions (width, depth, height), wall thickness, hinge diameter, and latch width, utilizing separate modules for the bottom box, top lid, and the latch buckle.
captions.factory: The script uses three main modules: 'bottom()', 'top()', and 'bottomLatch()'. The bottom and top boxes are created using 'difference()' on nested cubes to form hollow shells, with additional 'hull()' operations combining cylinders and cubes to form the hinge knuckles and latch mounts. Interlocking hinge fingers are cut out using a 'for' loop subtraction, and cylindrical rods are added for the hinge pivots. The 'bottomLatch' module creates a separate functional buckle using 'hull()' and 'cylinder()' primitives to snap onto the latch rod of the top lid.
